brand.name: Razorpay
brand.summary: Razorpay is an integrated financial technology platform providing businesses with full-stack payment processing, business banking, automated payroll, and credit solutions. It enables companies of all sizes—from solo freelancers to large enterprises—to accept online and in-store payments, disburse payouts, and automate financial operations.

competitor_analysis.brand_overview: A leading Indian fintech company providing end-to-end payment gateway services, international transaction handling, neo-banking (RazorpayX), corporate credit, and automated payroll systems.

competitors.name: Cashfree Payments
competitors.main_offering: Full-stack payment gateway, API payouts, and verification suites.
competitors.target_market: E-commerce, marketplaces, NBFCs, and digital platforms in India.
strengths: Strong developer APIs for bulk payouts
weaknesses_or_gaps: Smaller ecosystem footprint compared to Razorpay
Less mature neo-banking and corporate credit offerings

competitors.name: PayU India
competitors.main_offering: Omnichannel payment gateway, checkout optimization, and credit services.
competitors.target_market: Enterprises, D2C brands, and large volume e-commerce merchants in India.
strengths: High volume processing for tier-1 Indian enterprise brands
Deep local banking and processing relationships
weaknesses_or_gaps: Less seamless onboarding for micro-businesses and freelancers
Narrower business suite outside payment processing

competitors.name: Stripe
competitors.main_offering: Global payment infrastructure, cross-border payment acceptance, and subscription billing.
competitors.target_market: Global tech companies, SaaS providers, and cross-border startups.
strengths: Standard-setting developer documentation and modular APIs
weaknesses_or_gaps: Invitation-only or limited functionality for domestic Indian merchants
Lack of domestic-focused banking integration like RazorpayX
